notes: MEASURED from /proc/mtd on the reference device — same ~120 MiB onboard SPI-NAND layout as EthWAN WiFi Router. The reference build's actual root filesystem runs from a 32 GB reference card (mmcblk0p4, 14 GiB root partition, 1.7 GiB used) with a second 14 GiB slot (mmcblk0p8) likely reserved for A/B — not from this onboard flash. The measurement report explicitly states a 2 GB device is too tight for the observed 1.7 GiB root footprint plus A/B/recovery/persistent/log/growth needs, and recommends an 8 GB production baseline — far above the current 256 MB minFlashMB floor (Section 3, CRF-002). This reinforces, rather than resolves, the Section 3.7 flash-floor discrepancy. See Hardware Compatibility Specification Section 5.1.2 for the full evidence assessment.
